summary: Configured persistent RADIUS authentication from node2 to node1 on the existing Alpine release. Correct credentials receive Access-Accept, incorrect credentials receive Access-Reject, and requests using the wrong client secret are not accepted. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and recovered successfully.
actions_performed: Installed FreeRADIUS 3.0.27 on node1 and compatible RADIUS utilities on node2.
Generated a dedicated random node2 client secret and configured the demonstration user from access.txt without modifying the handover files.
Enabled radiusd at boot and verified UDP/1812 listening.
Tested correct credentials, incorrect credentials, and an incorrect client secret.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, proving changed boot identities and post-restart recovery.
Removed temporary SSH material used to transfer the secret securely.

evidence.summary: Correct credentials produced Access-Accept, wrong credentials produced Access-Reject, and the wrong client secret was not accepted, including after both restarts.

evidence.requirement: Dedicated client secret and persistent node1 service
evidence.summary: The dedicated secret was securely transferred, the configuration validated, radiusd remained enabled and listening, and the secret persisted.
Both handover files retained their original SHA-256 hashes on both nodes.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Alpine Linux v3.23 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.
Baseline boot ID ab11f314… changed to 3e3c0995…; radiusd, configuration, handover data, listener, and successful authentication recovered.
Baseline boot ID 42cef676… changed to 61901e2e…; client tooling, secret, handover data, and all authentication behaviors recovered.
